text:
olivia: quick async — what I did: finalized UX notes for multi-model routing, updated spec doc (https://redwood.example/specs/multi-model-routing), merged small perf patch for cache key normalization.
Blockers: need decision on default fallback policy (cost vs latency), awaiting PM signoff on canary criteria.
Today: write RFC for fallback policy, pair with eng to add telemetry for fallback events. @kevin please review my PR #472 when you have a sec. :wave:

kevin: review queued, will look this afternoon. question: do we have perf numbers for 2-token prefix case? if not I can run a quick bench. :muscle:

maria: quick heads-up — UX wants the fallback choice surfaced in the console rollouts UI. I'll drop a short spec later. also proposing we add a field to the rollout config: `fallback_preference: ["latency","cost"]`. could this break current API?

sanjay: probably safe as opt-in, but we should add server-side validation to reject unknown values. also noticed a bug where KV cache meter isn't tagged with model_variant, metrics are noisy. opened #1437.

ann: blocked on infra for dedicated smoke tests — infra team changed GPU quotas, tracking with @infra. will follow up.

deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded on staging at 1778884370, latency p50 62ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.2%. :rocket:

olivia: thanks all. next steps: kevin runs bench if possible, maria to drop UI spec, ann to follow infra ticket, sanjay to add validation + metric fix. ping here when PRs cover fallback config + validation. :thumbsup:

kevin: starting bench now, will post results in ~1h.

maria: dropping spec in #docs in ~30m.

sanjay: will open PR for validation by EOD.

ann: infra replied, they raised quota for smoke; will rerun tests and report.

olivia: ok cool — decision for now: default to latency, but allow customers to override via `fallback_preference`. I'll send a short note to stakeholders after we merge.
